structure: SFU = one core (unchanged ot_hgi_sfu_scheduled_engine: programme + IO calendar SRAMs, 80 operand SRAMs, 16 lanes) + 4 bank-pair LG boundary leaves (ot_hgi_sfu_lg_pair_leaf, 1 register edge each way, 34 rq + 562 wq out / 514 rr + 2 done in = 1,112 bits per pair) + R static die relays per pair (ot_hgi_sfu_lg_relay). Composition ot_hgi_sfu_split_engine; core LG_PATH = 1 + R so the bridge's fixed READ_RETURN/WRITE_RETURN are 14/11 + 2(1+R). No FIFO, credit or ready.
base: Codex per-pair LG clock-root split f94fb79fd + 80d1f4413 (cherry-picked, unchanged)
